title: The naive cotangent complex of henselization and strict henselization
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter more-algebra.tex (More on Algebra)
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-algebra.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The lemma compares the naive cotangent complex of a local homomorphism with the naive cotangent complex after passing to henselization or strict henselization: base changing the former along the henselization is shown to induce isomorphisms on cohomology with the latter. The proof uses that henselizations are filtered colimits of etale algebras, so the relative naive cotangent complexes appearing are acyclic, applies the Jacobi-Zariski sequence to the chain of ring maps to remove the intermediate step, and then invokes a six-term exact Jacobi-Zariski sequence associated to a colimit of local complete intersections to compare the base change of the original naive cotangent complex with the one over the henselization. The strict henselization case is asserted to follow in the same manner.
